League History

All-Time Records

Compare the best result in each season with the top 10 in the selected seasons. Records for the lowest values rank from lowest to highest. In-progress results reflect games played so far.

Filter by league era

Eras can overlap. Include adds matching seasons. Exclude removes matching seasons even if another era includes them.

League size
Two starting QBs, two team defenses and individual defenders. The 2004 lineup added a DB and a DL. Rushing and receiving yardage doubled from 2003 to 2004.
Yahoo's team count fell from 12 to 10 in 2005.
Draft
Yahoo roster import was off. Cross-season roster and draft matches increase sharply in 2012.
Yahoo roster import was on. Six of ten continuing managers drafted a player from their prior final roster in round one in 2012. All ten did so in the final round in 2017. Roster import was off in 2016.
Yahoo lists these drafts as non-auction and records no pick costs.
Yahoo flags the draft as an auction and records pick prices beginning in 2016.
Starting lineup
Both seasons had two QBs and two team defenses. Individual defensive slots went from one DB and one DL to two of each.
Nine starters including one team defense. The format returned in 2008 after two seasons with two starting QBs.
Fifteen starters including two QBs, three RBs, four WRs, two kickers, two team defenses and one individual defender.
The lineup dropped to ten starters while retaining the second QB.
A WR/RB/TE flex slot replaced the third WR slot in 2011.
The draft expanded from 14 to 16 picks per team and the typical bench grew from five to seven slots in 2019.
Scoring
Individual defense, return scoring, kicking and yardage rules changed repeatedly. In 2006, passing, rushing and receiving yardage rates were halved. Individual defense scoring was dropped again in 2007.
Passing returned to one point per 25 yards and rushing and receiving to one per 10. Passing TDs were worth six and catches a quarter point.
Passing TDs dropped from six to four and passing yardage from one point per 25 yards to about one per 30.
Receptions went from 0.25 to 0.5 points in 2017.
One point per rushing or receiving first down replaced half-PPR. Six-point passing TDs returned and return yardage began scoring again.
Schedule
Yahoo playoffs begin in Week 16 in these seasons. Season totals have more opportunities than in the shorter schedules.
Yahoo playoffs begin in Week 15.
Yahoo playoffs begin in Week 14.
